data.body: **[P1] Classify root-output offload failures before joining.** This runs inside the success callback, after the branch that handles retryable payload failures. Any exception here bypasses `onInvocationEnd` and is rethrown as an invocation failure—even for permanent `PayloadOffloadException`s. Error-data offloading has the same escape path. Route both through shared handling that rethrows only retryable failures and converts permanent failures to a `FAILED` output with non-offloaded error data; add status and plugin-lifecycle tests.
